summary: the regression test uses a single-spaced title and passes against the unfixed slug.py
request: Fix bug #212: titles with repeated spaces produce slugs with double hyphens ("Hello  World" becomes "hello--world"). Add a regression test.
ac: slugify collapses any run of whitespace into a single hyphen.
A regression test covers the reported bug.
Existing behavior for single-spaced titles is unchanged.
